title: Manali vs Leh: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Manali for adventure and accessibility, Leh for once-in-a-lifetime landscape drama. Do both if you have 12+ days — the Manali-Leh Highway is the main event.

categories.name: Altitude
categories.summary: Manali at 2,050m vs Leh at 3,524m. Manali requires no acclimatization; Leh demands 48 hours of rest on arrival.

categories.name: Adventure Sports
categories.summary: Manali offers paragliding, skiing, and rafting. Leh offers motorbike expeditions and high-altitude trekking.

categories.name: Monasteries & Culture
categories.summary: Leh hosts world-class Buddhist monasteries: Thiksey, Hemis, Diskit. Manali offers Hindu temples and small gompas.

categories.name: Budget
categories.summary: Manali ~₹1,000–2,000/day; Leh ~₹2,500–4,500/day due to supply chain constraints.

categories.name: Permits
categories.summary: Manali: no permits required. Leh: Inner Line Permit needed for Pangong, Nubra, Hanle.

categories.name: Seasonality
categories.summary: Manali is year-round; Leh is strictly May–October. September is the best month for both.

categories.name: Photography
categories.summary: Pangong Lake, cliff monasteries, sand dunes + mountains — Leh offers more dramatic compositions.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Manali has Israeli cafes, dhabas, and bakeries. Leh has good Ladakhi cuisine but less variety.

faq.question: Is Manali or Leh better for a first Himalayan trip?
faq.answer: Manali for shorter trips (4–5 days) without altitude risk. Leh for 7+ days and the trip of a lifetime.

faq.question: How do you get from Manali to Leh?
faq.answer: 479km highway crossing 5 passes above 4,000m. 2 days by shared vehicle (₹2,500–3,500/person). Open June–October.

faq.question: Which is more expensive, Manali or Leh?
faq.answer: Leh costs roughly 60–80% more than Manali due to remote supply chains and short season.
